meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: 发布 Claude Code 插件新版本时,Claude 会统一递增八个清单文件里的版本号,构建校验、打 git 标签、建 GitHub release、重生成 CHANGELOG,最后把 npm publish 留给你手动执行。
howto.when: 当你要求发布插件新版本、递增版本号或走发布流程时接管;npm publish 是最后一步,由你本人执行。

say.text: 把版本升到下一个 PATCH 版本并走完发布流程
这次是 MINOR 更新,帮我更新所有清单文件的版本号
say.note: 八个清单文件都会写入新版本号

say.text: 发布完成后验证 npm 上的版本并跑 Discord 通知
say.note: 会执行 npm view 查版本并发通知

howto.what_en: When releasing a new plugin version, Claude bumps the version string in all eight manifest files, builds and verifies, creates the git tag and GitHub release, regenerates CHANGELOG.md, and leaves npm publish to you.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to release a new plugin version, bump the version, or run the release workflow; npm publish is the final step you run yourself.

say_en.text: Bump to the next PATCH version and run the full release flow
say_en.note: Claude does everything, then stops for your npm publish

say_en.text: This is a MINOR change — update the version across all manifests
say_en.note: All eight manifest files get the new version

say_en.text: After publishing, verify the npm version and run the Discord notify
say_en.note: Checks npm view and sends the notification
